criteria: Main-story, historical, ancient-civilisation, prophecy and unresolved-mystery topics, plus timeline events.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Timeline
items.notes: Eras: Old World -> When the Doves Held Branches -> Unified Civilization -> War of Funerary Flame (~6000 ya) -> Interim -> Archon War (6000-2000 ya) -> Post-Archon War -> Pre-Cataclysm -> Cataclysm (500 ya) -> Post-Cataclysm -> Recent Past.

items.name: Archon War
items.notes: 6,000-2,000 ya; seven thrones opened in Celestia after WoFF; produced The Seven.

items.name: Cataclysm
items.notes: Fall of Khaenri'ah 500 years ago; includes the Curse of Immortality (Ronova) on pure-bloods and hilichurl curse (no standalone curse page on wiki). | 500 ya, teyvat-wide Abyssal calamity; also 'Dark Calamity'. Wiki insists on lowercase 'cataclysm'.

items.name: Destruction of Irminsul
items.notes: Song of the Welkin Moon Acts IX-X: Dottore infiltrates Irminsul; Nahida burns it with the Pyro Gnosis; only carbonized roots remain and Aaru takes over its functions; Fate no longer easily directed by Celestia.

items.name: Fall of Khaenri'ah
items.notes: Irmin's Abyss obsession, sibling as vessel, coup/rescue of Vedrfolnir, Sinners split the power, Heavenly Principles destroy Khaenri'ah, which triggers Saarelainen's curse (HP falls dormant). Anfortas evacuates survivors.

items.name: Fall of Ronova
items.notes: Black Feathers Scattered at Parting: Anastasya uses six Gnoses to stall Rhinedottir; Celestia revokes Ronova's Authority; Pierro (new Delusion), Dainsleif and Traveler defeat her; she dies after fusing the Eitr with a Nail. First Shade killed on-screen. Descriptive title.

items.name: Forbidden Knowledge
items.notes: Abyssal 'apocalypse' knowledge introduced by Nibelung; purged via Irminsul in Sumeru. | Abyssal 'apocalypse' information alien to Teyvat; caused Withering/Eleazar; Irmin's 'secrets from beyond the skies'; Hroptatyr's notebook (7.1). | merged system.forbidden-knowledge: May overlap with the lore/forbidden-knowledge scope. Included because it is a corrupting power (Sumeru withering, Eleazar). | merged term.forbidden-knowledge: Glossary pointer; lore.forbidden-knowledge holds detail.

items.name: Archon Quest (Overall Premise)
items.notes: Traveler + Paimon search Teyvat for the lost twin; chapter structure Prologue -> Ch I-V -> Song of the Welkin Moon -> Ch VII (Snezhnaya, Acts I-IV through 7.1). Ch ?? 'The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed' (Khaenri'ah) and Epilogue are unreleased placeholders - exclude content.

items.name: Prophecy of Fontaine
items.notes: Unofficial name. Fontainians born with sin; waters rise, all dissolve but the Archon weeps on her throne. Attributed to Egeria; slates possibly by Vedrfolnir. Fulfilled/averted in 4.2.

items.name: The Sibling's Goal
items.notes: Abyss Order leader who learned 'the truth of this world'; allied with Asmoday; ran an 'Atlas' experiment in Natlan. Final aims unresolved.

items.name: The Tsaritsa's Plan
items.notes: Anastasya gathers Gnoses (six held) to face the Heavenly Principles; her stated Authority is 'love'; records memories in a Transcription Prism. Endgame unresolved at 7.1.

items.name: Unified Civilization
items.notes: Planet-wide culture under the Heavenly Principles after the Sovereigns fell; Shades/angels walked among humans; destroyed after WoFF and its history forbidden.

items.name: War of Funerary Flame
items.notes: 6,000 years ago, Nibelung vs Heavenly Principles; destroyed the Three Moons, ended the unified civilization. | ~6,000 ya, 'Funerary Year': Nibelung (bringing the Abyss) vs Heavenly Principles; Eternal & Iridescent Moons destroyed, Frost Moon flung beyond false sky; Celestial Nails cast; ended the unified civilization. Not capitalized on wiki.

items.name: Fontaine/History
items.notes: Primordial Sea, Hydro Sovereign, Remuria, Egeria, Focalors.

items.name: Inazuma/History
items.notes: Byakuyakoku, Tsurumi/Thunderbird, Orobashi, Makoto's death, Vision Hunt.

items.name: Khaenri'ah/History
items.notes: Founding ~6000 ya, Crimson Moon & Eclipse dynasties, Irmin, Sinners, Cataclysm, Schwanenritter, Abyss Order founding.

items.name: Liyue/History
items.notes: Guili Assembly, Lisha civilizations, Chenyu Vale, Archon War, Cataclysm.

items.name: Mondstadt/History
items.notes: Arcadia/Elysium (Gunnhildr), Decarabian, Aristocracy, Vennessa.

items.name: Natlan/History
items.notes: Xiuhcoatl/Natlantea, Xbalanque, Night Warden Wars.

items.name: Snezhnaya/History
items.notes: Includes Hyperborea, Saarelainen/Anastasya, Belyi Tsar, Nod-Krai pioneering age, Lightkeepers, Fatui founding. No separate Nod-Krai/History page exists - Nod-Krai history lives here.

items.name: Sumeru/History
items.notes: Ay-Khanoum, Gurabad, Deshret, Rukkhadevata, Cataclysm, Irminsul's destruction (6.6).

items.name: Byakuyakoku
items.notes: Ancient Enkanomiya civilisation (Dainichi Mikoshi, Before Sun and Moon, Istaroth as Tokoyo Ookami). No own page; see Enkanomiya and 'The Byakuyakoku Collection'.

items.name: Conquest of the Seven Sovereigns
items.notes: Era 'When the Doves Held Branches': Heavenly Principles descend, create the Four Shades, defeat the Sovereigns in 40 years, seize Authorities, remake Light Realm into Human Realm. Distinct from the later War of Funerary Flame. No standalone page; title is descriptive.

items.name: Curse of Khaenri'ah
items.notes: Ronova's curse: pure-bloods get immortality (Dainsleif), others become hilichurls/Abyss creatures. No standalone page ('Curse of immortality' missing).

items.name: Eleazar
items.notes: Sumeru disease, bodily manifestation of the Withering/forbidden knowledge; eradicated when Rukkhadevata's tainted consciousness was purged from Irminsul.

items.name: Slumber of the Heavenly Principles
items.notes: Dormant since the Cataclysm due to Saarelainen's curse; Celestia still issues directives to Shades. When/if they wake is open. Descriptive title.

items.name: Holy Soil Crisis
items.notes: 7.1 cliffhanger: dying Ronova fuses the Eitr into a Nail of Retribution above the Cryo Dragon's corpse, crumbling it and threatening Holy Soil across Teyvat. Outcome after 7.1 unknown.

items.name: King Deshret's Civilization
items.notes: Desert kingdom; fall of Deshret via forbidden knowledge (Nabu Malikata); Aaru. Section heading on Timeline; page is the god himself.

items.name: Night Warden Wars
items.notes: Natlan's 500-year war against the Abyss beginning at Tenochtzitoc during the Cataclysm.

items.name: Paimon's Identity
items.notes: Pierro appears to know Paimon (7.0); her illness in Snezhnaya; long-running open question.

items.name: Project Mistilteinn
items.notes: Pierro/Armory Palace weapon project using Stellar Linchpins to fight the Heavenly Principles; blocked by Ronova's curse of death until her fall in 7.1.

items.name: Project Stuzha
items.notes: Fatui/Veche energy-austerity policy diverting Kresnik Kristall energy to the Armory Palace; suspended in Ch VII.

items.name: Return of the Frost Moon
items.notes: Climax of Nod-Krai arc: Sandrone's world-formula and allies pull the Frost Moon through the shattered false sky; Columbina defeats Dottore; Moon Marrows redistributed (Eternal to Lauma, Iridescent to Arlecchino). Descriptive title.

items.name: Teyvat Chapter Storyline Preview: Travail
items.notes: Dainsleif-narrated preview of each nation's arc; quasi-prophetic framing ('That throne in the sky is not reserved for you'). Released ~Nov 2020 (1.1 era) - version approximate.

items.name: Third Descender's Seal
items.notes: Crystalline seal under Zapolyarny Palace left by Saarelainen, guarded by the Belyi Tsar; reacts only to Gnoses; contents unknown even to Anastasya; needs all seven (Pyro Gnosis lost).

items.name: Traveler Acts (Abyss Order / Sibling Thread)
items.notes: Groups the Traveler-icon acts: We Will Be Reunited, Requiem of the Echoing Depths, Caribert, Bedtime Story, A Space and Time for You. Quest-level entries belong to the quest scope.

items.name: Vision Hunt Decree
items.notes: Raiden Shogun's confiscation of Visions; rescinded in 2.1.

items.name: Asmoday's Defection
items.notes: Ruler of Space who separated the twins later defected from Celestia and sided with the sibling/Abyss Order; reasons and plans unclear.

items.name: Future of Khaenri'ah
items.notes: Irmin 'indisposed' (fate unknown), Regent Anfortas, Rhinedottir called 'Mother of Khaenri'ah'. Announced but unreleased chapter 'The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed' - do not use.

items.name: Guili Assembly
items.notes: Guizhong & Morax's early settlement; fell in the Archon War.

items.name: Istaroth's Intentions
items.notes: Ruler of Time who nudged the sibling to abandon Khaenri'ah and repeatedly meddles (Venti, Makoto, Zibai, Direidyth). Motives unclear.

items.name: Nature of the Abyss
items.notes: Originates from the sea of stars; per Barbeloth it is the hatred of unrealized fates. Its full nature and the 'darkness spreading across the cosmos' remain open.

items.name: Ochkanatlan (Civilization)
items.notes: Natlan's lost tribe; site later used as Abyss Order HQ (A Space and Time for You). introduced_in uncertain.

items.name: Project Lunar Veil
items.notes: Maagees-Geti & Lusalim's cloaking veil; Lusalim's research was given to the Heavenly Principles and became the false sky.

items.name: Project Moongazer
items.notes: Dragon researchers on the Frost Moon relaying the Stellar Blackbody warning about cosmic darkness; Old World era. Likely 6.x.

items.name: Sacred Heir Prophecy
items.notes: Frostmoon Scions' 5,000-year eugenic project to produce the 'Ruler of Elysium'/Primordial Human (Avrelian = Reed Miller; Aila/Alia). Also see Frostmoon Scions, Sampo Mill. Version approximate.

items.name: Sakoku Decree
items.notes: Inazuma's closed-border policy, lifted after Ch II.

items.name: Khaenri'ah's Savior
items.notes: Universitas Magistrorum implied to have predicted the twins' arrival; Irmin declared the sibling heir and 'Savior' and used them as a vessel for Abyssal power. No standalone page.

items.name: Tatarigami
items.notes: Orobashi's curse-residue afflicting Yashiori/Seirai; Inazuma history.

items.name: The Withering
items.notes: Forbidden-knowledge corruption of Sumeru's land; wiki page is partly gameplay.

items.name: Thunderbird Civilization
items.notes: Tsurumi Island's Ainu-inspired people (Kanna Kapatcir, Rite of Parting).

items.name: The Twins' Origin
items.notes: Twins once ruled a planet destroyed by a 'star-devouring darkness'; their spaceship lies on the Frost Moon (flight logs, 6.3). Links to Stellar Blackbody/cosmic Abyss.

items.name: Chichen Uctokah
items.notes: Natlan ancient civilisation listed on Lore Navbox.

items.name: Sal Terrae (Civilization)
items.notes: Liyue ancient civilisation listed on Lore Navbox.

items.name: Tribes of Fontaine
items.notes: Pre-Remurian/pre-Egeria peoples; listed on Lore Navbox.
